mapping.draft_py:
# Portal of Sanctuary. "Return target creature you control and each Aura attached to it to their
# owners' hands" = two MOVE_ZONEs to Zone(HAND, OWNER) in printed order: the targeted creature
# (B11 bounce shape, "target creature you control"), then Turn to Slag's "all Equipment attached to
# that creature" selector with the Aura subtype. "Activate only during your turn." is the activation
# gate condition FAtom(TURN_OF, YOU) ("During your turn", Discontinuity / Radha).
creature = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
    filter=FAnd(children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    )),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
auras = Selector(
    count=QUnbounded(),
    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
    filter=FAnd(children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACHED_TO, referent='target'),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Aura'),
    )),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
portal = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)), CostTap())),
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {'cards': creature, 'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER)}),
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {'cards': auras, 'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER)}),
    )),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
)
abilities = [portal, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {1}, {T}: Return target creature you control and each Aura attached to it to their owners' hands.

mapping.notes: Packs portal_of_sanctuary/pack_auras.json (the creature and both Auras on it, yours and the opponent's, go to their owners' hands; an Aura on another creature stays) and pack_turn_gate.json (refused on the opponent's turn: 'illegal activation: condition:false') pass. The Aura step runs after the creature moved and still finds the attachments.
